remarks:
Charming Older Home with Modern Updates!
Step into the character and charm of this updated older home, thoughtfully deigned for today’s lifestyle. The spacious mudroom provides a convenient entryway and features first-floor laundry, along with plenty of storage space. The first floor half bathroom adds convenience. The open kitchen offers plenty of workspace, flowing nicely into the formal dining room and inviting living room. An additional first-floor room provides flexible space that could be used as a home office, den, or playroom. Hardwood floors and original woodwork add warmth and timeless character throughout the home. An open staircase with a bench seat leads to the second floor, where you’ll find three bedrooms and an updated full bathroom. The second floor also features built-in wood cabinets, providing additional storage while adding to the home’s classic appeal. A finished attic offers versatile additional space that could be used as a 4th bedroom, home office, playroom, guest space, or whatever best suits your needs. Outside, enjoy a two-car garage, large carport, and a spacious backyard lot with plenty of room for outdoor activities, gardening, or entertaining. A wonderful combination of historic charm, modern updates, and practical living space!
